entries.title: The complexity of theorem-proving procedures
entries.key_innovation: Analyzes the computational complexity of theorem-proving procedures, establishing theoretical bounds on their behavior.

entries.title: Symbolic model checking without bdds
entries.key_innovation: Introduces SAT-based bounded model checking as a way to perform symbolic model checking without using BDDs.

entries.title: Combining decision diagrams and sat procedures for efficient symbolic model checking

entries.title: On the application of sat solvers to the test suite minimization problem
entries.key_innovation: Encodes test suite minimization as a SAT problem so SAT solvers can find minimal test sets satisfying coverage criteria.

entries.title: Optimization of combinatorial testing by incremental sat solving

entries.title: Software model synthesis using satisfiability solvers

entries.title: Satisfiability solvers are static analysers

entries.title: Model and program repair via sat solving
entries.key_innovation: Encodes subtractive model repair as SAT, using satisfying assignments to remove states/transitions so a Kripke structure satisfies a CTL formula, with abstraction extensions.

entries.title: Specification-based program repair using sat
entries.key_innovation: Encodes specification-based program repair as a SAT problem, using satisfiability solving to find program changes that satisfy a specification.

entries.title: Verification of proofs of unsatisfiability for cnf formulas

entries.title: Inprocessing rules

entries.title: Verifying refutations with extended resolution
